proposals.evidence: Full medas gives Bshk mä̃ fat, Shina mī̃ fat and Shumasti mīə̃ animal fat, alongside Kalasha meʰ/mɛ̃. These support Bshk mā/mã/mae/mā̃/maʔ and Maiya/Bhateri mīū̃/mīõ/mī̃õ. Keep source glottalization and vowel sequences; the precise local phonetics and transmission remain qualified. Do not collapse the distinct majjan and medya families into this parent. Exact response: mīū̃.
